supporting_news.title: Eurozone bond yields rise as investors return to riskier assets, oil prices rebound
supporting_news.summary: Eurozone government bond yields edged higher as investors shifted back towards riskier assets and oil prices rebounded amid escalating Middle East tensions. Markets also assessed the European Central Bank's policy outlook, with money markets pricing in two 25-bps rate hikes by June 2027, despite expectations of a weekly decline in yields.

supporting_news.title: India bonds decline ahead of fresh debt sale as elevated oil prices fan inflation worries
supporting_news.summary: Indian government bonds decreased in early trading due to rising oil prices and cautious investor sentiment. The benchmark 6.94% 2036 bond yield increased significantly amid higher expectations for a rate hike. New Delhi is set to raise 330 billion rupees through a bond sale, contributing to market tension. Concerns over food-price pressures and inflation continue to influence the Reserve Bank of India's upcoming decision.

supporting_news.title: India bonds slump as oil spike adds to RBI hike bets
supporting_news.summary: Indian government bonds experienced a decline this week, largely influenced by rising oil prices and US Treasury yields. The benchmark bond yield reached its highest point in a week at 7.2650% on Friday. Analysts are anticipating a potential increase in interest rates from the Reserve Bank of India in their upcoming policy decision. A surge in oil prices raises inflation concerns, especially since retail inflation exceeded the RBI's tolerance threshold.
